provenance: real IBM AMLworld HI-Small transactions (Altman et al., Kaggle ealtman2019/ibm-transactions-for-anti-money-laundering-aml, CDLA-Sharing-1.0). IBM states the corpus is entirely SYNTHETIC -- generated by a multi-agent virtual world, not real customer data. These are the engineered features finance_aml.gbm was trained on, unlike the 8-feature PaySim sample this page uses for the FHE/MPC pipeline.

input.layout: samples[i] is one row of the 32 features below

expected.note: Stratified to contain positives -- AMLworld's real prevalence is ~1 in 981, so an unstratified draw would be all-negative and accuracy would be vacuous.
